name: WNBA_R3A4_FIRST_OOS_FAMILY_ABLATION_CONTRACT_V1
purpose: Test whether strictly prior-date Four Factors provide reproducible incremental out-of-sample probability value conditional on the frozen R2 selected side. This gate does not search an Elite threshold and does not claim an 80 percent regime.

frozen_inputs.required_join: Exact one-to-one join on season + gameId across all 1269 rows; no post-result row dropping.

population.rolling_origin_rule: For target season Y, fit only on seasons strictly less than Y.

orientation.base_side: Frozen R2 selectedSide for each game.
orientation.factor_orientation: Every Four Factors differential is multiplied by +1 for HOME-selected rows and -1 for AWAY-selected rows so positive always means advantage for the frozen R2 selected side.
orientation.reason: This first nested test isolates whether Four Factors add probability information without confounding the result with a new side-selection policy.

training_only_preprocessing.factor_standardization: For each fold and each of the eight factors, subtract training-fold mean and divide by training-fold population standard deviation. Target-season values never influence means or standard deviations.
training_only_preprocessing.zero_variance_rule: If a training factor standard deviation is <= 1e-12, its standardized value is fixed to 0 for both train and target fold and the event is reported.

reference_model.algorithm: Exact deterministic 1D Platt semantics from frozen cross-sport-calibration blob 9099ed5182d64b6e20768b6d305e7867ed2b69ce.
reference_model.required_parity: Reference intercept and slope must match the frozen R2B2 fold values to absolute tolerance <= 1e-9 before the augmented model is evaluated.

augmented_model.form: sigmoid(intercept + beta_base*base_logit + sum(beta_j*z_j)) for the eight frozen standardized Four Factors advantages.
augmented_model.optimizer: Deterministic multivariate Newton/IRLS generalization of the frozen 1D Platt algorithm.
augmented_model.penalty: Intercept unpenalized; beta_base and all eight factor slopes receive identical L2 ridge lambda.
augmented_model.initial_parameters: intercept=0, beta_base=1, all eight factor slopes=0.
augmented_model.singular_hessian_rule: Fail the gate; no alternate optimizer or hyperparameter is permitted after target outcomes are evaluated.

metrics.accuracy_note: Selected-side accuracy is invariant in this fixed-side ablation and cannot be used to admit or reject Four Factors.

paired_uncertainty.method: Season-stratified paired bootstrap of target rows.
reported: 95 percent percentile CI for augmented-minus-reference Brier
95 percent percentile CI for augmented-minus-reference log loss

frozen_incremental_value_gate.primary: At least one pooled proper-score improvement must be statistically directional: the 95 percent bootstrap upper bound of augmented-minus-reference Brier OR log loss must be < 0.
frozen_incremental_value_gate.secondary_proper_score_non_degradation: If Brier is the qualifying metric, pooled log-loss degradation may not exceed +0.005. If log loss is the qualifying metric, pooled Brier degradation may not exceed +0.002.
frozen_incremental_value_gate.ece_non_degradation: Pooled ECE10 degradation may not exceed +0.010.
frozen_incremental_value_gate.season_breadth: For at least one qualifying proper score, augmented point performance must improve over reference in at least 3 of the 5 target seasons.
frozen_incremental_value_gate.fail_interpretation: FOUR_FACTORS_NOT_ADMITTED_BY_THIS_FROZEN_ABLATION; no post-result optimizer, feature, or gate change is allowed within R3A4.
